recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of three individuals seated on a yellow velvet sofa against a dense, orange and yellow 1970s floral wallpaper. The scene features a foreground glass table with a record player and drinks, framed by a dark border with clean, modern typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject trio centered against a busy, high-pattern background
Warm, directional lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on clothing
Modern sans-serif footer contrasting with retro serif header typography
Color harmony between the mustard sofa, floral wall, and earth-toned wardrobe
coreInvariants: 1970s floral wallpaper pattern in orange, yellow, and white
Glass-topped table with a record player in the lower center foreground
Dark, solid-colored frame or letterbox border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects seated mid-ground, occupying the horizontal center; the central figure is slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The record player in the lower center acts as the base anchor, leading up to the central figure's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright floral background to the subjects' faces, down to the record player, and finally to the bold text in the footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with pattern and texture, with negative space reserved for the dark border at the bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow and burnt orange (wallpaper and sofa)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep olive green and tan (clothing) against the bright background
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background patterns; high value contrast between the subjects and the dark foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or purples except as minor highlights

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of high-contrast transitional serifs and geometric sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Header uses thick vertical strokes with thin horizontal serifs
Footer uses uniform stroke weight with open apertures
Sub-header text is enclosed in a pill-shaped container
characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters in the primary title to create a logo-like lockup
Custom horizontal bars extending from the sub-header container
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for branding paired with a clean geometric sans for informational clarity.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines with star-like terminals

avoid: Distressed or grunge textures on type

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of the top branding.
Provides the clean, modern geometric feel for the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photo of three people in 70s earth-toned clothing sitting on a yellow velvet couch. The background is a bright orange and yellow floral wallpaper. In the foreground, a glass table holds a record player and two glasses of whiskey. The entire image is framed by a thick black border at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large high-contrast serif title at the top center. Below it, add a small pill-shaped button containing sans-serif text. At the very bottom, inside the black border, place bold white geometric sans-serif text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the wallpaper pattern dense and retro?
Is the lighting warm and directional?
Is the footer text centered in the dark border?
Does the header text have high stroke contrast?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the trio
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the record player is clearly visible in the foreground.
Check that the floral pattern does not overwhelm the subjects' faces.
Verify the bottom text is perfectly centered and legible.
Confirm the warm color grade is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Retro Studio Portrait = (70s Floral Wallpaper + Velvet Furniture) + (Trio Subject Composition) + (High-Contrast Serif Header / Geometric Sans Footer) / Warm Earth-Tone Palette.
